intro.statement: For more than 28 years we have put diagnostic imaging within reach of hospitals, clinics and field programmes —
intro.statement_em: engineered and manufactured in India, supported wherever it is installed.
intro.body: 392+ government and 3,106+ private hospitals run Edusoft systems today, served from 13 branch offices and a growing presence across Nepal, Bangladesh, the Philippines, the Middle East, Singapore, Africa, Latin America and the USA.

ecosystem.title: One imaging ecosystem.
ecosystem.sub: Acquisition, digitisation, output and software — each designed to work with the rest.

tech.title: Engineered around the image chain.
tech.sub: Every Edusoft system is built on four links. Strengthen each one and the diagnosis gets clearer.

steps.title: High-frequency generation
steps.body: From 210 W handhelds to 80 kW ceiling-suspended rooms, inverter generators at 80–270 kHz deliver stable, low-ripple output for consistent images at lower dose.

steps.title: Wireless flat panel detectors
steps.body: ERAY Gold detectors pair CsI scintillators with amorphous silicon: 100 μm pixels, 73% DQE, IP56 housings and a full image on screen in two to three seconds.

steps.title: Acquisition software
steps.body: Edusoft IAS and ERAY ImageSuite (CDSCO approved) correct grid and exposure errors, stitch long-length studies and hand images to PACS over DICOM 3.0.

steps.title: Output and archive
steps.body: TRIMAX dry laser imagers up to 650 ppi, the Made-in-India ERAY thermal imager, PACS, RIS and tele-radiology put every study where it is needed.

featured.title: Built for the rooms that never stop.

items.title: Bedside & critical care
items.body: Battery-driven mobile X-ray brings imaging to the ICU, emergency and neonatal wards — no transfers for patients who cannot be moved.

items.title: Operating room
items.body: Flat panel C-Arms with pulse fluoroscopy, dual laser centring and DICOM 3.0 for orthopaedics, trauma, spine, urology and pain management.

items.title: Radiology department
items.body: Ceiling-suspended and floor-mounted DR rooms with auto-positioning, paired with dry laser imagers and PACS for high-volume departments.

items.title: Screening & outreach
items.body: Sub-4 kg handheld X-ray and AI reading support for TB screening programmes, outreach camps, disaster sites and home care.

items.title: Veterinary
items.body: ERAY SMART and RAD systems are built for human and veterinary use; ERAY Gold detectors ship with veterinary measurement tools.

about_page.title: Pioneering healthcare
about_page.sub: Edusoft Healthcare Limited improves healthcare outcomes through innovation and synergy — pairing technologies from the world’s leading medical companies with Made-in-India products manufactured in our own factory.
about_page.story_title: Transforming radiography for more than a decade.
about_page.story_body: Edusoft has grown from a trusted distributor into a manufacturer of mobile, fixed and handheld X-ray systems. Our installations span 392+ government and 3,106+ private hospitals across India, with reach extending to Nepal, Bangladesh, the Philippines, Latin America, Dubai, Singapore and Africa.
about_page.story_body2: We serve hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres and veterinarians — and we measure ourselves by one word: bharosemand, trustworthy.
